Title: Conservative therapy with metformin plus megestrol acetate for endometrial atypical hyperplasia
Author: Shan et al.
Comment: The paper reports a final analyzed completer sample of 8 patients per arm after initially enrolling 30 patients; arm-specific randomized sizes before exclusions are not reported. The extracted denominators are therefore analyzed completers. The paper reports no odds ratio or confidence interval, so these fields are left null. The reported p=0.105 concerns the response-distribution comparison and is attached to the CR result because this is the paper’s reported between-group test at this endpoint.
Design Type: Controlled, single-blinded, prospective randomized two-group pilot study

Recruitment source: Outpatients of the Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital of Fudan University
Outcome measurement: Complete response was defined as reversion of endometrial atypical hyperplasia to proliferative or secretory endometrium on histological examination of post-treatment dilation and curettage specimens
